name: Café Twilight
source:
It's somewhere far away, over the edge of the world. It is a strange coffee shop that is only open at twilight. A lot of "storytelling music" from all over the world and ancient times is played there. The music played by the owner and his customers sometimes brings laughter, sometimes comforts the lonely, sometimes shares blessings, and sometimes Healing the heartbreak and gently being with you now...

[From Google Play Store]
translation:
它在遥远的地方，在世界的边缘。这是一家奇怪的咖啡店，只在黄昏时营业。那里演奏着很多来自世界各地和古代的“讲故事的音乐”。店主和顾客演奏的音乐时而带来欢声笑语，时而抚慰孤独，时而分享祝福，时而治愈心碎，温柔地陪伴在你身边……

[来自Google Play商店]
